About accessories in Kenya

Batteriq is an authorised Anker, Soundcore and Eufy dealer as well as an EcoFlow and BLUETTI dealer, so this page collects the add-ons that complete a backup setup and the everyday tech that keeps you charged and secure.

Read moreShow less

Anker power banks and chargers: 57 products from KES 950. Soundcore earbuds, headphones and speakers: 83 products from KES 1,740. Eufy security cameras and smart home: 25 products from KES 2,140. EcoFlow and BLUETTI extra batteries: 11 products from KES 27,949, such as the EcoFlow EB300 Extra Battery (RIVER 3).

The Anker range covers 26 power banks, 20 wall chargers, 7 car chargers, 4 USB-C hubs, 22 cables. Soundcore covers 49 earbuds, 14 headphones, 19 speakers. Eufy adds indoor and outdoor security cameras, video doorbells, smart trackers and home sensors.

Choosing a power bank or charger comes down to three numbers on its product page: capacity in mAh (how many phone charges it holds), output in watts (how fast it charges; laptops usually need USB-C at 45 W or more), and the ports you need. During KPLC outages a power bank keeps phones and Wi-Fi hotspots running, while a power station covers the rest of the house.

Extra batteries add capacity to a compatible power station; check the expandable spec on your station first. Every unit is genuine and covered by a 24-month warranty. Pay by M-Pesa, card or cash on delivery, with same-day delivery in Nairobi and delivery to all 47 counties with an eTIMS invoice.

Frequently asked questions

Are your Anker, Soundcore and Eufy products genuine?

Yes. Batteriq is an authorised Anker, Soundcore and Eufy dealer in Kenya, so every unit is genuine. Every unit is genuine and covered by a 24-month warranty.

Which extra battery fits my power station?

Extra batteries are model-specific: each one lists the station it fits, and we stock 11 of them. Check your station's "Expandable to" spec, then send us the model on WhatsApp and we will confirm the right battery and cable.

Do you have power banks for phones and laptops?

Yes. We stock 26 power banks from KES 2,850, such as the Anker ZOLO POWER BANK (10K, 22.5W, BUILT-IN USB-C CABLE) BLACK. Check the capacity and output on each product page against your phone or laptop, or ask us on WhatsApp which one charges your device fastest.

Do Soundcore earbuds work with iPhone and Android?

Soundcore earbuds, headphones and speakers connect over Bluetooth, so they pair with iPhone and Android phones, tablets and laptops. Each product page lists its own features; message us on WhatsApp if you want help choosing.

How fast is delivery for accessories?

Pay by M-Pesa, card or cash on delivery, with same-day delivery in Nairobi and delivery to all 47 counties with an eTIMS invoice.
